# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(treemap)
library(patchwork)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)
```

# Load data

```{r}
hpa_data_v24 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24/hpa_data_v24.csv")
head(hpa_data_v24)

hpa_data_v25 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
head(hpa_data_v25)

uniprot_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/uniprot_v24.csv")
head(uniprot_data)

ortholog_data <- read_tsv("../data/Orthologs/orthologs_259_missing_proteins.txt")
head(ortholog_data)
```

# Counting missing proteome

## v.24 - Missing proteome

```{r}
v24_missing <- hpa_data_v24 |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` == "No human protein/transcript evidence")

nrow(v24_missing)
```

## v.25 - Added through cell type and cell line data

```{r}
v25_missing <- hpa_data_v25 |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` == "No human protein/transcript evidence")

nrow(v25_missing)


v_24_v_25_missing <- v25_missing |>
  filter(Ensembl %in% v24_missing$Ensembl)

# Genes which have evidence in v.24 but not in v.25
v25_missing |>
  setdiff(v_24_v_25_missing) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24, by = "Ensembl")
```

## UniProt evidence

```{r}
missing_proteome <- v25_missing |>
  filter(!Ensembl %in% (uniprot_data |> 
                          filter(`Uniprot evidence` == "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)" |
                                   `Uniprot evidence` == "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)"))$Ensembl) 

# Missing proteome that has no Uniprot evidence
nrow(missing_proteome)

# UniProt contributing evidence
nrow(v25_missing) - nrow(missing_proteome)
```

## Has GO terms (BP, MF, CC)

```{r}
missing_proteome_with_go <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |>
               select(Ensembl, `Biological process`, `Molecular function`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  filter(!is.na(`Biological process`) | !is.na(`Molecular function`))

missing_proteome_with_go
nrow(missing_proteome_with_go)
missing_proteome_with_go |> count(`Biological process`)

missing_proteome_no_go <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24, by = "Ensembl") |>
  filter(is.na(`Biological process`)) |>
  filter(is.na(`Molecular function`))

missing_proteome_no_go
nrow(missing_proteome_no_go)

missing_proteome_no_go |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 4/missing_proteome.xlsx")

missing_proteome_no_go |>
  select(Ensembl, Gene = Gene.y, `Gene synonym`, `Gene description`, `HPA evidence` = `HPA evidence.x`, Chromosome, Antibody) |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 4/missing_proteome.xlsx")
```

## GO terms

```{r}
make_treemap_save <- function(df, column, 
                              max_categories = 50, 
                              title = "Treemap",
                              file_prefix = "treemap",
                              out_dir = "") {
  # Prepare counts (split, flatten, count)
  items <- df %>%
    dplyr::pull({{ column }}) %>%
    stringr::str_split(", ") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    .[. != ""]
  tab <- as.data.frame(table(items))
  tab <- tab %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(Freq)) %>% head(max_categories)
  
  # Set up filename
  file_base <- paste0(out_dir, file_prefix, "_", gsub(" ", "_", title))
  png_file <- paste0(file_base, ".png")
  pdf_file <- paste0(file_base, ".pdf")
  
  # PNG
  png(png_file, width = 1200, height = 900, res = 120)
  treemap(tab,
          index = "items",
          vSize = "Freq",
          title = title,
          fontsize.title = 20,
          fontsize.labels = 16,
          align.labels = list(c("center", "center")),
          border.col = "white",
          palette = "Set2")
  dev.off()
  # PDF
  pdf(pdf_file, width = 12, height = 9)
  treemap(tab,
          index = "items",
          vSize = "Freq",
          title = title,
          fontsize.title = 20,
          fontsize.labels = 16,
          align.labels = list(c("center", "center")),
          border.col = "white",
          palette = "Set2")
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", png_file, "and", pdf_file, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
if(!dir.exists("../plots/pdf/Figure 4")) {
  dir.create("../plots/pdf/Figure 4", recursive = TRUE)
}

if(!dir.exists("../plots/png/Figure 4")) {
  dir.create("../plots/png/Figure 4", recursive = TRUE)
}

make_treemap_save(
  missing_proteome_with_go,
  `Biological process`,
  max_categories = 50,
  title = "Missing proteome: Biological process",
  file_prefix = "missing_Biological_process",
  out_dir     = "../plots/pdf/Figure 4/"
)

make_treemap_save(
  missing_proteome_with_go,
  `Molecular function`,
  max_categories = 50,
  title = "Missing proteome: Molecular function",
  file_prefix = "missing_Molecular_function",
  out_dir     = "../plots/pdf/Figure 4/"
)
```

```{r}
p1 <- make_treemap_save(missing_proteome_with_go, `Biological process`,
                     max_categories = 50,
                     title = "Missing proteome: Biological process")
p2 <- make_treemap_save(missing_proteome_with_go, `Molecular function`,
                     max_categories = 50,
                     title = "Missing proteome: Molecular function")

combined_missing <- p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2)

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 4/Combined_Missing_Treemaps.pdf", combined_missing, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/figure 4/Combined_Missing_Treemaps.png", combined_missing, width = 14, height = 7)
```
